DESIGN PREVIEW / OCTOBER 2026

A few things
worth making clear.

Your enquiry stays in your browser.

The enquiry composer prepares text for you to copy or download. It does not send a message, submit data to a server or create a booking. There is no enquiry database in this draft.

Personal details are still your choice.

Portrait, biography, employer, social profiles, résumé and any job-search notice are placeholders until the owner chooses what to include. Empty social labels are not links to assumed accounts.

Demonstrations are labelled.

Project pages distinguish public demonstrations, internal tools and concepts. The six catalogue covers are unedited screenshots of public pages. A screenshot of a concept page is not proof of an implemented application. Technical simulations do not certify engineering design, real-world performance or safety.

External services.

This draft loads fonts from Google Fonts. Opening a project or repository takes you to a separate website with its own hosting and privacy practices. No analytics, advertising or tracking scripts have been added to this portfolio.

Before a public launch.

We will confirm personal information, contact details, domain setup, language versions and the final contact workflow. Any collection of enquiries or analytics needs a separate, accurate privacy description for that implementation.
